name: TX-37
label: Safe D

key_factors: Casar's large fundraising and cash advantage
Markets price a Democratic win near certainty
No competitive polling or expert ratings to move the race
model.rationale: The D+30 baseline is strongly supported by Casar's roughly ten-to-one fundraising edge, a large cash advantage, and Polymarket pricing the race at about 97% Democratic. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting competition, the forecast stays at Safe D.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race or a major outside-spending surge for Peña would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Casar, the Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored in this Austin-based district with a D+30 partisan lean. He has raised about $1.17 million and holds nearly $600,000 in cash, while Republican Lauren Peña has raised roughly $118,000 with under $1,000 on hand and no outside support. Prediction markets give Casar about a 97% chance of winning.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the forecast rests on fundamentals, money, and market pricing. The expected margin is roughly 29 points, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling.
